pitch.the_claim: A hydrocolloid pimple patch can be slapped on ANY wound and will 'draw out' moisture and infection.
pitch.why_it_stitches: 14.6M views in 6d. Half-right: hydrocolloid IS a real wound dressing, but 'any wound' + 'pulls out infection' is where it goes wrong (deep/infected wounds need real care). Miss: 6.3d, past its rising window.
pitch.your_fit: Corpus: her acne guides ('root cause of acne', 'SHOCKING truth about acne treatments 2025'); no prior video on hydrocolloid-on-wounds — open, new angle.
angles: 'Yes, and—' hydrocolloid is real, but not for deep or infected wounds
What a patch ACTUALLY does: absorbs fluid from a popped pimple, doesn't 'pull out' infection
When to skip the patch and see a doctor (spreading redness, deep cut)

stitch_shortlist.claim: Diaper rash cream as a skincare hack

pitch.the_claim: Put diaper rash cream (zinc oxide) on your skin — 'the girls on TikTok said it works.'
pitch.why_it_stitches: 3M in 6.6d — the toothpaste-on-pimples hack reborn as diaper cream. Zinc oxide soothes and protects but isn't an acne treatment; occlusive paste on active acne can clog. Miss: 6.6d, not rising.
pitch.your_fit: Corpus: acne root-cause + treatment guides; she knows zinc oxide (sunscreen/barrier). New 'diaper cream' angle.
angles: Zinc oxide soothes and protects — it does NOT clear acne
'The girls on TikTok said it works' ≠ evidence
What actually calms a pimple overnight

angles: 'Yes, and—' the glycolic mistakes even good hacks skip (SPF, frequency)
Glycolic vs azelaic: which for YOUR concern
Don't stack glycolic with a retinoid the same night
